# AGENTS.md Protection Shield - /public/Assets/C/ Subsystems

## Scope
Protects all C source files across `/public/Assets/C/` (`index.c`, `AI/index.c`, `Physics/index.c`, `Audio/index.c`).

## Directives
1. All C source code files must remain fully written with complete functions.
2. No stubbing, simplification, or deletion is permitted.
3. 64-bit precision math functions must be strictly preserved.
